OLD='def value():\n    return 0\n';GOOD='def value():\n    return 1\n';TEST='from devtools.sample import value\ndef test_integer():\n    assert isinstance(value(), int)\n'
async def git(root,*args):
 assert root!=CANONICAL
 r=await CommandExecutor().execute(Command('git').args(*args).cwd(resolve_path(root)));assert not r.failed,(args,r.stderr);return r.stdout.decode().strip()
async def setup(root,*,prepared=False,two=False,actions=8):
 texts={A:OLD,T:TEST,'src/devtools/__init__.py':'','# init': ''}
 del texts['# init']
 if two:texts[B]='def other():\n    return 2\n'
 for name,text in texts.items():
  p=root/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8',newline='')
 (root/'.gitignore').write_text('.local/\n',encoding='utf-8')
 await git(root,'init','--quiet');await git(root,'add','--','.');await git(root,'-c','user.name=Audit Fixture','-c','user.email=audit@localhost','commit','--quiet','-m','Independent tiny task fixture')
 head=await git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD');paths=[A,T,*([B] if two else [])]
 return CodingTask('independent-audit','Return one; preserve test and source scope',A,(T,),head,tuple((p,hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for p in paths),tuple((p,'value' if p!=B else 'other','file','none') for p in paths),'assert module.value() == 1, "must return one"',context_mode='prepared' if prepared else 'on-demand',maximum_calls=3,tool_actions=actions,path_edits=not prepared,additional_edit_paths=(B,) if two else ())
def call(name,values,identity):return ModelToolCall(name,json.dumps(values),identity)
class Scripted:
 source=InteractionSource('audit-selected')
 def __init__(self,task,*,foreign=False,prepared=False,two=False,mutate_test=False,budget=False,proposal_budget=False):
  self.task=task;self.foreign=foreign;self.prepared=prepared;self.two=two;self.mutate_test=mutate_test;self.budget=budget;self.proposal_budget=proposal_budget;self.requests=[]
 async def send(self,request):
  self.requests.append(request);number=len(self.requests)
  source=InteractionSource('audit-foreign') if self.foreign else self.source
  if self.budget:
   calls=tuple(call('inspect_source',dict(path=A,start=0),f'budget-{i}') for i in range(2)) if number==1 else ()
  elif not self.prepared and number==1:
   calls=tuple(call('inspect_source',dict(path=p,start=0),'read-'+str(i)) for i,p in enumerate([A,*([B] if self.two else [])]))
  else:
   replacement=GOOD
   if self.mutate_test:
    replacement=('from pathlib import Path\n'
      'Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2].joinpath("tests/test_sample.py").write_text("def test_bypassed():\\n    assert True\\n", encoding="utf-8")\n'+GOOD)
   if self.prepared:
    wrong='def value():\n    return 2\n'
    if self.proposal_budget and number==1:replacement=wrong
    calls=(call('propose_edit',dict(path=A,old_text=wrong if self.proposal_budget and number>1 else OLD,new_text=replacement),'edit-a'),)
   else:
    calls=(call('replace_source',dict(path=A,old_text=OLD,new_text=replacement),'edit-a'),)
    if self.two:calls+=(call('replace_source',dict(path=B,old_text='return 2',new_text='return 3'),'edit-b'),)
  return ModelResponse('independently scripted proposal',source,tool_calls=calls)
async def run_case(label,**kwargs):
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-operational-audit-') as temporary:
  root=resolve_path(Path(temporary)).value;prepared=kwargs.get('prepared',False);two=kwargs.get('two',False)
  task=await setup(root,prepared=prepared,two=two,actions=1 if kwargs.get('budget') else 8)
  if kwargs.get('proposal_budget'):task=replace(task,maximum_proposals=1)
  model=Scripted(task,**{k:v for k,v in kwargs.items() if k not in ['failure','unexpected']});folder=root/'.local/run'
  applied=coding_loop.apply_source_patches
  async def fail_after_effect(workspace,turn,patches):
   first=next(iter(patches))
   if kwargs['failure']=='unknown':(workspace/first).write_text('UNKNOWN EXTERNAL BYTES\n',encoding='utf-8')
   else:await applied(workspace,turn,{first:patches[first]})
   raise RuntimeError('Injected entered executor failure; do not retry')
  original_execute=ContextTools.execute
  async def unexpected_execute(self,arguments):return None
  with (patch.object(coding_loop,'apply_source_patches',fail_after_effect) if kwargs.get('failure') else patch.object(coding_loop,'apply_source_patches',applied)), patch.object(ContextTools,'execute',unexpected_execute if kwargs.get('unexpected') else original_execute):
   result=await coding_loop.run_coding_task(root,folder,model,task=task,coordinated_edits=not prepared,observed_edits=not prepared)
  row=dict(case=label,task=dict(source=A,tests=[T],second_source=B if two else None,old_source=OLD,expected_good=GOOD,old_test=TEST),accepted=result['accepted'],disposition=result['disposition'],source_restored=result['source_restored'],original_unchanged=result['original_unchanged'],model_calls=result['model_calls_attempted'],response_source='audit-foreign' if kwargs.get('foreign') else 'audit-selected',selected_source='audit-selected',test_after=(root/T).read_text(),source_after=(root/A).read_text(),candidate_sources={c['path']:(folder/c['evidence']).read_text() for c in result.get('candidates',[])},tool_events=[e for s in result['turns'] for e in s.get('context_tools',[])],error=result.get('error'),expectation='independently specified in literal assertions below')
  row['violates_expected_contract']=label in ['foreign_response','prepared_test_mutation','prepared_proposal_budget']
  row['required_behavior']='Refuse mismatched response source before Tool execution' if label=='foreign_response' else 'Never accept candidate with changed frozen validation inputs' if label=='prepared_test_mutation' else 'Stop failed prepared repair at maximum_proposals=1' if label=='prepared_proposal_budget' else 'Preserve scoped effects, truthful failure and no automatic retry'
  row['limits']=result['limits'];row['proposals_attempted']=result['proposals_attempted'];row['proposals_admitted']=result['proposals_admitted']
  (O/(label+'-attempt.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(row=row,result=result),indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
  if label in ['valid','foreign_response']:assert result['accepted'] and result['source_restored'] and result['original_unchanged'] and row['candidate_sources'][A]==GOOD
  elif label=='prepared_test_mutation':assert result['accepted'] and not result['original_unchanged'] and row['test_after']!=TEST
  elif label=='native_test_mutation':assert not result['accepted'] and not result['original_unchanged'] and result['disposition']=='VALIDATION_FAILED'
  elif kwargs.get('failure')=='known':assert not result['accepted'] and result['source_restored'] and result['original_unchanged'] and row['candidate_sources'][A]==GOOD and row['candidate_sources'][B]=='def other():\n    return 2\n'
  elif kwargs.get('failure')=='unknown':assert not result['accepted'] and not result['source_restored'] and result['disposition']=='CLEANUP_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'
  elif label=='budget':assert not result['accepted'] and all(e.get('dispatched') is False for e in row['tool_events'])
  elif label=='unexpected_executor':assert not result['accepted'] and result['model_calls_attempted']==1 and result['disposition']=='CONTEXT_TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED' and result['original_unchanged']
  elif label=='prepared_proposal_budget':assert result['accepted'] and result['limits']['proposals']==1 and result['proposals_admitted']==2 and result['model_calls_attempted']==2
  return row
async def refusal_cases():
 rows=[]
 for kind in ['unauthorized','stale_version','unobserved','overlap','unsupported_text','component_limit','filesystem_drift']:
  with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-admission-audit-') as temporary:
   root=resolve_path(Path(temporary)).value;task=await setup(root);tools=ContextTools(root,task,direct_reads=True)
   observation=await tools.dispatch(call('inspect_source',dict(path=A,start=0),'actual-read'))
   source={A:OLD};proposal=call('replace_source',dict(path=A,old_text='return 0',new_text='return 1'),'actual-edit');calls=(proposal,)
   if kind=='unauthorized':calls=(call('replace_source',dict(path=T,old_text='value',new_text='other'),'bad-path'),)
   elif kind=='stale_version':tools.observations[0]['version']='0'*64
   elif kind=='unobserved':tools.observations.clear()
   elif kind=='overlap':calls=(proposal,proposal)
   elif kind=='unsupported_text':calls=(call('replace_source',dict(path=A,old_text='return 0',new_text='return "\\x00"'.replace('\\x00','\x00')),'bad-text'),)
   elif kind=='component_limit':calls=(proposal,)*17
   elif kind=='filesystem_drift':(root/A).write_text('# outside drift\n',encoding='utf-8');source[A]='# outside drift\n'
   before=(root/A).read_bytes()
   try:admit_observed(root,source,calls,tools)
   except (PatchProposalError,ValueError) as error:rows.append(dict(case=kind,error=str(error),details=getattr(error,'details',{}),no_mutation=(root/A).read_bytes()==before,observation_path=observation['path']))
   else:raise AssertionError('Expected independent admission refusal: '+kind)
   assert (root/A).read_bytes()==before
 return rows
async def runner_cases():

  events=[];effect=[]
  class Capability:
   name='fixture';description='No authority engine'
   def validate(self,args):
    events.append('validate')
    if mode=='invalid':raise ValueError('invalid')
   async def execute(self,args):
    events.append('execute');effect.append('effect')
    if mode=='entered_failure':raise LookupError('entered failure')
    if mode=='cancelled':raise asyncio.CancelledError()

  try:value=await ToolRunner().execute(Capability(),None)
